description: A standard battery of unknown brand. Increases the Battery life by +2 seconds. "Another nearly empty battery."
A leather strip wrapped around the Flashlight for more grip. Increases the Aim accuracy by +20 %. "Too many have fallen due to sweaty hands."

A tiny Flashlight bulb that packs more wattage for a brighter, more powerful light beam. Increases the brightness of the Beam by +20 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +10 %. "Even the most powerful light cannot pierce through The Black Fog's darkness."

A thin wide lens in perfect condition.Designed to spread the Flashlight beam at the cost of reducing its range of effectiveness. Increases the width of the Beam by +25 %. Reduces the reach of the Beam by -25 %.

A thick glass lens that focuses the Flashlight beam to increase its intensity. Increases the reach of the Beam by +25 %. Increases the brightness by +20 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +10 %. Reduces the width of the Beam by -15 %.
A battery marked as "industrial strength". Increases the Battery life by +4 seconds. "A battery advertised as lasting 8 hours lasts only a couple of seconds in The Black Fog."
A filament bulb designed to extend a Flashlight battery's life. Reduces the Battery Depletion rate by -24 %.
A rubber grip specifically fitting Flashlights for more grip. Increases the Aim accuracy by +40 %.

A lens and reflector combo which can magnify a Flashlight's beam. Increases the brightness of the Beam by +30 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +15 %. "Let the light burn them out of their dark shroud."
A chemical bulb that generates an intensely clear light. Increases the brightness of the Beam by +40 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +20 %.
A recent model of battery that lasts longer. Extends the Battery life by +6 seconds.

A wide lens made of unscratchable sapphire that optimises the power and range of the light beam. Increases the reach of the Beam by +25 %. Increases the brightness of the Beam by +30 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +15 %. Reduces the width of the Beam by -25 %.

A heavy and completely opaque bulb of unknown origin which emits a faint light even when turned off. Increases the brightness of the Beam by +50 %. Increases the duration of a successful Blind by +25 %. Increases the Battery Depletion rate by +14 %.
Tightly knitted rope used in praying rituals. Increases the Use time of Keys by 10 seconds. "Pray all you want, your words are getting lost somewhere up there, in the Fog."

A heavily worn out token made of brass.If an inscription or drawing was once engraved in it, it has today completely disappeared. The Auras of other Survivors within 24 metres are revealed to you while Mind Channel is active. Eroded Token does not stack with Gold Token.
A chain of matte beads of various sizes used in praying ritual. Increases the Use time of Keys by 15 seconds.

A porous and scratched white pearl.A minuscule jump ring allows the pearl to be attached to the key. Increases the Aura-reading range of Keys by +12 metres. "Pray all you want, your words are getting lost somewhere up there, in the Fog."

A gold token with a dull appearance.Both faces are smooth and void of any inscriptions. The Auras of other Survivors within 48 metres are revealed to you while Mind Channel is active. Gold Token does not stack with Eroded Token.

A blood-red amber striped with black veins.The amber is warm to the touch. The Aura of the Killer within 32 metres is revealed to you while Mind Channel is active. Increases the Depletion rate by +100 %.
This opaque piece of glass emits a dull vibrating noise.Channels the Black Fog's energy. Using a Key to open the closed Hatch consumes this Add-on instead.

An engraved wedding ring that emerged from the Fog and resonates with an indescribable and incomprehensible energy. The Aura of the Obsession is automatically revealed to you at all times. This does not require using the Mind Channel ability. Reduces your chance of becoming the initial Obsession by reducing the default value by -100 %.

A mundane key ring in appearance with an unusual bluish dark sheen.The ring binds the Key to its user, preventing loss even in the darkest of times. Causes this Add-on to be consumed upon death instead of the Key.
A fragmented piece of a thick fibrous material.A partial and faded map is drawn on it which by itself is useless. Increases the Durability of the Map by +5 seconds.

A strange bead circled with gold that can be used to magnify the map and mark a specific position.The bead emits an energy which can be felt and seen by Survivors. Press the Secondary Action button while using the Map to use the Glass Bead to place a Pillar of Light at your current location that can be seen by all Survivors.
A bristly and rough piece of twine of a deep red colour.Can be tied around the Map to enhance its Aura-reading ability. Unlocks the ability to track Killer Belongings.
A slimy, translucent substance with a ghastly lavender shade.This jelly from unknown origin is highly resistant to heat. Reduces the Depletion rate by -20 %.
A wooden stamp with a cross-hatched rubber pad used to mark documents.It is unclear as to how or by whom this stamp was originally used. Increases the Object Tracking range by +8 metres.

A small electrical wire.Both ends are heavily damaged like it has been forcefully torn out of its intended location.Can be tied around the Map to enhance its Aura-reading ability. Unlocks the ability to track the Exit Gate Switches
A smooth black cord with a soft appearance.Can be tied around the Map to enhance its Aura-reading ability. Unlocks the ability to track the Hatch.
A stamp carved out of sturdy blonde wood.The text found at the base is incomprehensible: "kw'zvre'od". Increases the Object Tracking range by +12 metres.

An intricate set of lenses wrapped up in an astonishingly complex apparatus.The gears controlling the lenses' focus move by themselves as to focus on something invisible to humans. Reveals the tracked Auras to all Survivors.
A pack of bandages usually found in First Aid Kits. Increases the available Healing Charges by +8 Charges.
Medical quality tape used to close small wounds. Increases the Healing speed by +5 %.
Disposable medical gloves to avoid cross-contamination. Increases the Great Success zone of Healing Skill Checks by +10 %.
Scissors designed to easily cut through textiles. Increases the Healing speed by +10 %.

Not exactly a medical device.However, it can be used to quickly and painfully close up a wound. Increases the Odds of triggering Healing Skill Checks by +10 %. Increases the Progression bonus for succeeding at Great Healing Skill Checks by +5 %.

A pack of bandages that stick to themselves without the need of clips for a faster patch-up that requires less readjustments. Increases the Healing speed by +5 %. Increases the available Healing Charges by +8 Charges.
A mundane sponge used to soak up extra blood, providing easier access to wounds. Increases the Great Success zone of Healing Skill Checks by +20 %.
A sterile gauze used for a variety of wounds.Part of a total wound care system. Increases the available Healing Charges by +10 Charges.

A medical device used to close and hold body tissue.Even though it is very effective, the surgical suture is challenging to use. Increases the Odds of triggering Healing Skill Checks by +15 %. Increases the Progression bonus for succeeding at Great Healing Skill Checks by +10 %.
A highly absorbent pad that prevents bodily fluid leakage when applied to large abdominal wounds. Increases the Healing speed of Med-Kits by +15 %.

A white powder with coagulant properties.Apply the agent to a wound to stop it from haemorrhaging. Press the Secondary Action button while healing yourself or another Survivor with a Med-Kit to use the Styptic Agent to grant the Endurance Status Effect for 5 seconds. Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action. Styptic Agent consumes the Med-Kit on use.

An anti-haemorrhagic substance that stops the bleeding in a matter of seconds. Press the Secondary Action button while healing yourself or another Survivor with a Med-Kit to use the Anti-Haemorrhagic Syringe to automatically heal the affected Survivor for 1 Health State over the next 16 seconds. Healing Speed modifiers affect the Healing time. Taking damage or being picked up by the Killer cancels the Healing effect. Anti-Haemorrhagic Syringe consumes the Med-Kit on use.
A pack of gel forming pads used to patch up heavily exuding wounds. Increases the available Healing Charges by +16 Charges.
A mundane rag. Suspiciously clean. Increases the Repair speed of the Toolbox by +20 %.
Someone quickly painted what seems to be repair instructions on this piece of bark. Suppresses all normal Skill Checks that are usually triggered while repairing a Generator.
Springs, screws and gears. Mostly unusable junk. Increases the Capacity of the Toolbox by +8 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A rudimentary cutting tool made from a jagged metal wire and two wooden handles. Increases the Sabotage speed of the Toolbox by +20 %.
Thick gloves, which reduce manual dexterity but protect hands from injury. Suppresses the Loud Noise Notification to the Killer that is usually triggered after sabotaging a Hook.
Swivels provide bend and flexibility for bolts that are out of reach, deep within mechanical devices. Increases the Repair speed of the Toolbox by +30 %.
Useful tool to clamp hoses or hold wires in place and prevent damage or injury. Reduces the range at which your Generator-Repair noises can be heard by -8 metres.
A portable but heavy spool of copper wire. Increases the Capacity of the Toolbox by +12 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0An adjustable wrench with a tough grip.Essential in any Toolbox. Increases the Auto-Repair timer for sabotaged Hooks by +20 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A small hand saw mounted with a metal cutting blade. Increases the Sabotage speed of the Toolbox by +30 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.1.0This intricate mechanical part feels oddly out of place.It is clean and shiny as if straight out of the factory. Press the Use Item button while standing next to a Generator to perform the Install Brand New Part action: Triggers a difficult Skill Check. Permanently reduces the Repair requirement by -10 Charges for that Generator upon succeeding the Skill Check. Brand New Part is consumed on use.
Part of the standard Clown apparel, the cut fingers allow for dexterous manipulations. Increases the Throw speed of Bottles by +25 %. Reduces the Throw angle of Bottles by -15 °.
Be the life of the party! Bottles emit confetti when they break in addition to their usual effects. Hitting Survivors directly with a Bottle grants 100 bonus Bloodpoints in the Deviousness Category.
A warm orange feather, soft to the touch. Reduces the Cool-down duration between successive Bottle throws by -40 %.
An all time classic.You will not see things quite the same again. Switches the colours of the Gas Clouds with one another.
A thin and clear combustible liquid which numbs the mind when inhaled. Survivors affected by Intoxication suffer from the Blindness Status Effect for 30 seconds.
A chemical volatile compound that irritates the respiratory tract, but increases absorption of the Afterpiece Antidote. Increases the Invigoration duration by +1 second.
A black feather with an emerald gloss, very soft to the touch. Reduces the Cool-down duration between successive Bottle throws by -50 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.2It's sugary sweet, with only a little blood on the label. Increases the strength of the Haste Status Effect from Invigoration by +2 % .
A sturdy cork fitting the Afterpiece Tonic Bottles marvellously. Reduces the Reload time of the Bottles by -0.5 seconds.
A sweet-smelling organic compound with strong anaesthetic capabilities. Increases the size and spread of the Intoxication Gas Clouds by +20 %.
A potent chemical which causes irritation, burns and lung damage. Increases the strength of the Hindered Status Effect Survivors suffer from during Intoxication by an additional -4 %.
A mouldy inner sole which gives much comfort to tired feet. Increases your Movement speed while reloading Bottles by +66 %.
A pungent chemical compound consisting of ammonia.One whiff is enough to jolt even the most sluggish of minds. Increases the size and spread of the Invigoration Gas Clouds by +20 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.0A thin and clear combustible liquid which numbs the mind when inhaled. Survivors affected by Intoxication suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.2When the night is rough and the day is rougher, a little hair of the dog will give you a boost. Increases the strength of the Haste Status Effect from Invigoration by +3 % .

A grim and incomplete collection of fingers.Fills The Clown with longing and focuses his chemical crafting abilities. The Auras of all other Players within 16 metres of their location are revealed to Invigorated Players for 6 seconds.
A highly volatile organic compound, toxic at this concentration. Increases the Intoxication duration by +1 second.
Some for the face and some for the Antidote.The unknown compound intensifies the Antidote's effect. Increases the Invigoration duration by +2 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.0The prized pinkie finger of a redhead.Faintly fragrant.Tastes of potpourri and varnish. Survivors hit directly by Bottles suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for as long as they are affected by Intoxication. Reduces the number of carried Bottles to 1. This number cannot be modified by other Add-ons.
The prized middle finger of a large tattooed man.Has a faint taste of machinery oil. The Auras of Survivors afflicted by either Intoxication or Invigoration are revealed to you for 6 seconds.
Melted animal fat that can lubricate the Bear Traps squeaky joints. Setting a Bear Trap is silent.
A scratched and worn brace made of thick, cured animal skin. You are no longer caught in your own Bear Traps, they are automatically disarmed instead.
These padded jaws are meant to restrain, not to wound. Bear Traps immobilise Survivors without damaging them. Grants 100 % bonus Bloodpoints for trapping Survivors.
Protective padded leather gloves. Increases the Setting speed of the Bear Trap by +30 %.

A replacement kit for Bear Traps which changes the usual dual spring system to four coil springs, adding a great amount of strength to the Bear Traps hold. Increases the Disarm time of the Bear Trap by +33 %.
An old rusted can containing damp coffee grounds. Increases the strength of the Haste Status Effect after setting a Bear Trap by +5 % .
Jaws with long teeth that dig further into the flesh than a conventional Bear Traps. Survivors who escape from Bear Traps suffer from the Deep Wound Status Effect.

These replacement trap jaws have saw-like blades, causing awful open wounds when they snap. Survivors injured by a Bear Trap suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect until fully healed. "Like a predatory beast, it can smell and track blood."
A block of wax used to lower friction and facilitate movement in mechanical parts. Increases the Rescue and Escape times of the Bear Trap by +33 %.

A specialised set of tools used to fasten Bear Traps to ensure their effectiveness. Increases the Rescue and Escape times from the Bear Trap by +25 %. Increases the Setting speed of the Bear Trap by +50 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.0These Bear Trap jaws are covered with crusty and volatile rust spots, making injuries particularly difficult to heal. Survivors injured by a Bear Trap suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.
A secondary coil keeps the Bear Trap functional in times when the primary coil becomes unusable. Increases the Disarm time of the Bear Trap by +50 %.
A black, matte and sticky substance that when applied to Bear Traps, makes them far less noticeable. Darkens the Bear Trap.
A cured leather waist bag.Large and sturdy to transport hunting equipment. Increases the number of carried Bear Traps by +1.

When used with the Bear Trap, the stone sharpens its blades. The razor-sharp blades inflict deep wounds aimed at bleeding the victim as fast as possible. Survivors caught in a Bear Trap, who free themselves, are inflicted with the Dying State.
A clear oil that makes handling the Bear Trap's spring more hazardous. Resetting a Bear Trap reveals the Aura of the last Survivor to have disarmed it for 5 seconds.
A high tension spring that snaps back into place after being stretched. Automatically resets the Bear Trap 2 seconds after a Survivor escaped from it.
A crude leather sack suitable for foraging. Causes all Bear Traps to be carried in your inventory at the beginning of the Trial. You can no longer pick up any placed Bear Traps, only reset them.

Part sticky, part slippery, this grim liquid makes handling the Bear Traps spring more dangerous. When a healthy Survivor disarms a Bear Trap, the Bloody Coil exacts its price, putting the Survivor into the Injured State.
Bear Traps sharpened with the sickly gleaming stone seem to gain a life of their own. Automatically resets and arms a random disarmed Bear Trap every 30 seconds.
A type of corn common in South America.A few kernels are reason enough for a crow to stop for a snack. Increases the Timer before idle Dire Crows disintegrate by +2 seconds.
There is little left but a few globs of black and grey, yet Carmina could paint an expansive landscape with them. Increases the Detection radius of Killer Instinct by +1.5 metres.
Sticky, viscous sludge that Carmina used for an experimental piece.Once it sticks to skin, it is nearly impossible to get off. Increases the Repel duration for Swarmed Survivors by +0.5 seconds.
Scrap newspaper, speckled with bright, eye-catching paint.It seems tragedy is a daily thing. Increases the duration of Killer Instinct by +3 seconds.
An experimental drawing Carmina made without conscious planning.Do not think — act. Reduces the Cool-down time of Birds of Torment by -1.5 seconds after idle Dire Crows disintegrate.
A stomach-churning pile of meat and guts, yet it attracts hungry crows craving a bite. Reduces the Cool-down time of Birds of Torment by -0.5 seconds after launching Dire Crows.
An ink drawing of a dead crow.Carmina's sadness over its death can be felt with each dark line. Increases the Timer before idle Dire Crows disintegrate by +4 seconds.

A canvas that was targeted with swipes and trashes of black paint following Matias' death.It radiates with heavy, crippling sorrow. Swarmed Survivors suffer from a -15 % Hindered Status Effect for 1.5 seconds.

A striking red fabric Carmina used on an art project.Its brightness contrasted against black feathers. The Auras of Swarms continue to be revealed to you for another 1.5 seconds after Survivors start repelling them.

A stick of charcoal that conceals anything it rubs over. The Auras Dire Crows mid-flight are no longer visible to Survivors. The Auras of Dire Crows are visible to Survivors for 0.5 seconds after summoning them.

An unnatural ink, so wretched and dark that it seems to pull in light around it. Swarmed Survivors suffer from the Blindness Status Effect. This effect lingers for 15 seconds after repelling the Swarm.
An abstract ink drawing that Carmina drew before walking to the Death Leap. Swarmed Survivors suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect.
A shiny trinket that a crow took a liking to.The clinking of the bell was a distraction to everyone but Carmina. Swarmed Survivors suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.0A nest that remained empty near Carmina's home.There are sharp thorns embedded in it. Survivors suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 70 seconds after being damaged by Dire Crows.

An unusual egg that seems to be nothing but a ball of semi-solid ink. Increases the number of summonable Dire Crows by +1. Reduces the Timer before idle Dire Crows disintegrate by -2 seconds. "Perhaps, covered in darkness as I was, they saw me as one of their own." — Carmina Mora

A grieving reminder to Carmina that Matias would be with her, always watching. The Auras of Survivors within 5 metres of idle Dire Crows are revealed to you for 3 seconds. "See you soon, Matias." — Carmina Mora

Carmina's severed hands, cut from her arms shortly before her death.The sight brings sheer fury to her and her protectors. Causes Survivors coming within 3 metres of Swarmed Survivors to become swarmed too. "How are you going to paint now?" — Hooded Man

Carmina's tongue, cut from her mouth shortly before her death.The sight instils rage not just in her, but in her crows. Reduces your Slow-down time by -0.5 seconds after launching Dire Crows. "How are you going to tell poems now?" — Hooded Man

A nude self-portrait in which Carmina depicts a rotting darkness growing outwards from within. Survivors suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 4 seconds after repelling the Swarm. "I see no salvation in the rot." — Carmina Mora

A glass-like feather moulded from The Fog itself.Simple as it may be, it is a symbol of those who watch over Carmina. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect when Birds of Torment is on Cool-down and you hold no Dire Crows. Reduces the number of summonable Dire Crows by -1. "They saved me when I could not save myself." — Carmina Mora

A handful of small, pristine flower clusters covered in a fine greyish fur. The Auras of Survivors tripping Phantasm Traps are revealed to you for 3 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.6.0A handful of mud with veins of deep crimson. The bloody layers empower the mud. Reduces the Trigger range of Phantasm Traps by -30 %.

Three frail willow branches attached to form a triangular wreath. The Auras of Survivors tripping Phantasm Traps are revealed to you for 5 seconds.

The cannibal village deaf boy's ear.Deformed due to several hits to the head.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power: Survivors suffer from the Deafened Status Effect for 6 seconds after triggering a Phantasm Trap.

The cold heart of the cannibal village elder.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power. Whenever Survivors trigger Phantasm Traps, you benefit from the following effects for their tripped duration: Suppresses your Terror Radius. Doubles the range of the Fake Terror Radius emitted by the Mud Phantasms to 16 metres. "Bring me another slice of the girl." — Grandma

Shackles once used to hold prisoners and carcasses in the cannibal village cellar.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power. Suppresses any indication to Survivors that they tripped Phantasm Traps. Suppresses the creation of Mud Phantasms.

The cut up, severed hand of the cannibal village butcher.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power. Grants collision with Survivors to both Phantasm Traps and the Mud Phantasms. Grants +300 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Deviousness Category. Disables your ability to teleport to tripped Phantasm Traps. Scarred Hand trumps all other Add-ons. "..." — The Butcher

A small piece of cotton torn from the dress worn by Lisa Sherwood on the day she disappeared.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power. Press the Active Ability button to teleport to any untripped Phantasm Trap anywhere in the environment. Mint Rag has a cool-down of 10 seconds.

A child's shoe, long lost in the bog's waters.The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power. Permanently increases the default Movement speed by +7.5 % to 4.73 m/s. Survivors suffer from a -9 % Hindered Status Effect within the Trigger range of Phantasm Traps. Disables your ability to teleport to tripped Phantasm Traps.
A monocle Talbot rarely used despite his eyesight weakening in later years. Unlocks the ability to see the Target location of a Slam.

This early sample failed to achieve desired results, but demonstrated surprising effects regardless. Causes you to automatically face the nearest Survivor within 16 metres of your location after a Slam.
A poisonous plant that sparked Talbot's interest in chemistry.It rekindles deeply buried memories. Reduces the duration of Fatigue by -0.25 seconds.
A pill that is utterly ineffective... or is it? Reduces your Movement speed during a Rush by -15 %. Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints for Rush Score Events.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.5.0A rat that briefly returned to life when injected with Putrid Serum, becoming aggressive and uncontrollable. Increases your Movement speed during a Rush by a stack-able +2 % for each consecutive Lethal Rush.
A sizeable thorn snipped from a Visceral Canker.It secretes a mild toxin. Reduces the duration of Fatigue by -0.5 seconds.
A sample of bile from The Plague distilled and treated with a mixture of chemicals. Increases the Turn rate during a Rush by +10 %.
Dried Pustula Petals ground into a fine dust. Increases the duration of the Chain Rush Window by +0.75 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.7.0The remnants of Talbot's notes, they still contain some valuable information within. Reduces the Recharge time per Power Token by -0.33 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.5.0A hormone removed from an unwilling subject's adrenal gland.Though it provides a jolt of energy, it can fatigue its user. Increases the number of available Power Tokens by +2. Increases your Movement speed during a Rush by +5 %. Increases your maximum Look angle during a Rush by +20 °. Reduces your Turn rate during a Rush by -0.5 °/s. "Please, don't do this..."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.5.0A dead crow that has been grotesquely mutated by Putrid Serum. Increases your Movement speed during a Rush by a stack-able +3 % for each consecutive Lethal Rush.
A serum that's fatal to humans.It evokes beneficial qualities in those who are... something more. The Auras of Survivors within 8 metres of a Slam are revealed to you for 3.5 seconds.
A mixture made with dried roses from the exceedingly rare New Moon Bouquet. Increases the duration of the Chain Rush Window by +1 second.
Regular sea salt that has momentarily passed through the Spirit World, altering its properties in the process. Increases the Turn rate during a Rush by +15 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.5.0A ring given to chemists graduating from the London School of Medicine.It is a reminder of unrestrained ambition. Extends the Rush duration by +20 % for each consecutive Lethal Rush. "The student is accused of grave-robbing with the intent of unsanctioned scientific testing." — Faculty Reprimand of Talbot Grimes, 1838

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.7.0A chemical squeezed from the pineal gland of a recently deceased Survivor. Increases the initial Movement speed of a Rush by +5 %. "...suspected to cause atypical alterations in neural rhythmic activity." — Unlabelled Mystery School Text

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.7.0Talbot used this stone to carve what he believed was his research into the Opium Den's walls. Increases the initial duration of a Rush by +0.5 seconds. "Death is only the beginning."

The journal of a man who claimed to have returned from The Void.The knowledge within has practical applications. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect during a Rush. "In a wasteland of forgotten dreams and endless routine, the man with a way out is God." — Talbot Grimes

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0Talbot's penultimate attempt at a serum.Though it did not facilitate his escape, it did have powerful side effects. Blighted Corruption is capped at 5 Tokens. Increases your Turn rate during a Rush by +11 %. Increases the duration of a Rush by +11 %. "Time is scarce. Let this be the one..." — Talbot Grimes

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A glass-like laboratory tag, moulded from The Fog itself.Either a gift from The Entity or a cruel jest to tag The Blight as he once did to others. Blighted Corruption is capped at 3 Tokens. Increases your Movement speed during a Rush by +10 %. Increases your maximum Look angle during a Rush by +20 °. "Progress requires drastic change." — Talbot Grimes
A wooden figure that had caught young Victor's eye.He shrieked until his mother stole it from the market, nearly blowing their cover. Unlocks the ability to see the Target location of a Pounce.
A metal bottle filled with milk that has since soured.Loud as Victor could be, he quieted down when presented with his meal. Increases the Shriek radius of Victor by +2 metres.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.7.0Charlotte had many ways to mourn Victor's death.As the fingernails loosened from his rotting hands, she took one in remembrance. Reduces the Unbinding time of Victor by -0.25 seconds.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.7.0A minuscule toy sword, only a few inches long.Holding it brought out a violent enthusiasm in Victor. Reduces the Charge time of a Pounce by -0.1 second.
Two teeth that Victor lost long ago.They are unusually sharp. Survivors suffer from the Blindness Status Effect for 30 seconds after removing Victor.
A hood from one of the men that hunted Charlotte.Soon, he became the prey. Reduces the Transition time when switching back to Charlotte by -0.5 seconds.
An eyeball that belonged to a cat eaten by the starving Deshayes family.Victor hid it from his mother, using it as a toy. Suppresses all noise made by Victor while holding a Pounce.
